svg.title: P3: guided scheduling calculations for 24 products and 4 workers
svg.desc: Four output cells each equal 24. For each cell, the illustrated guided model takes chunks of 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 2, and 2 products. Remaining unassigned work is divided by four, rounded up, and bounded below by two. Worker assignments are illustrative.
svg.text: P3 · parallel_k · see guided chunks shrink
How the chunk size is calculated at every request
Illustrated model: take = min(R, max(2, ceil(R / 4)))
R = products not yet assigned; 4 = team size; 2 = minimum chunk.
Chunk widths show the number of products; the final chunks stay at the minimum of 2.
Then repeat for C[0,1], C[1,0], C[1,1], with a new k-team for each cell.
One permitted guided model. OpenMP can use different chunk calculations and worker assignments.
